preSpeech.message: One moment, let me check that date.

function.name: check_payment_date
function.description: CALL it every time the customer names a payment day or a period, before you say anything about that day. date = the day as YYYY-MM-DD read from the calendar in your instructions, or 'vague' when the customer gave no exact day. product_id = the product the date is for. The decision is read out after the call; do not judge the day yourself.

product_id.description: product id from the account result

date_relay.name: date_relay

on_enter.prompt: First, if the customer's last message asked you a question or said something your instructions require you to respond to, answer it in one short sentence. Then say this decision exactly, word for word, without changing any day, date or amount: "{{date_say}}" Do not call any tool. Say nothing else about which days are possible.

date_relay.task_message: First, if the customer's last message asked you a question or said something your instructions require you to respond to, answer it in one short sentence. Then say this decision exactly, word for word, without changing any day, date or amount: "{{date_say}}" Do not call any tool. Say nothing else about which days are possible.

transition.description: the date check produced a new decision

instructions: Add `tool` to node negotiate's tools. Put `transition` FIRST in negotiate's transitions. Add `nodes` to the workflow. In the negotiation prompt: call check_payment_date for every day or period the customer names; never say yourself whether a day is allowed; after the decision is read out, continue from it. The last decision is in {{date_decision}} (ok, not_business_day, after_deadline, past, ask_exact, propose_deadline, error) and the date to use is {{date_proposed}}.
